observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 45 stand in the left margin and the locators «p. 197.» (L18) and «p. 198.» (L39, beside the head of chapter 55) in the right margin. body L19, L38: the letters of the references (c) and (d) are bold italic.

body L21, L23: the n of «cosinum» is printed blotted; a speck stands before «Hanc»; it is not a point.
body L29, L30: a speck stands over the second e of «habebis» (L29); the dot of the i of «idest» (L30) is printed long and slanting, like an acute accent.
body L33: the comma after «converte» is printed as a thin slanting stroke without its head.
body L13: a speck stands in the left margin beside the line; it is not a sign.
body L32: the hyphen of «secun-» is printed short and round, like a point.
